events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Betrothal

options.text: May this tie our nations together.
No, I will not place this burden of [character] so young.

events.text: A message arrives from [character], congratulating you on the birth of [character]. The ruler of [rival] suggests that you enter an arrangement where [character] and the young prince [character] of [rival] are promised to wed under your [religion] faith.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Death in Birth

options.text: Trust in the Priests to see you through.

events.text: Your screams wrack the halls of the palace for hours as you fight to bring [character] into the world with no break or rest but wave after wave of exhaustion. By the time morning breaks the child is finally in your arms, but the birth has taken its toll. You are struck down with a severe fever that leaves you weak and frail. [character] seems to notice something amiss and hurries to your side, urgently warning that there was a problem with the birth and you are in great danger if he does not act now. However, the [religion] healers who assisted in the birth are furious at the implication that they did something wrong.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Tutorial: Succession

options.text: This is a day for celebration!

events.text: Your family line has a new Heir, [character]! Training strong Heirs will be vital for the survival of your nation as once your current Ruler is gone, someone will need to take the reins. Once your Heir has grown up a bit, you'll be able to choose an educational path to guide them into the role you need them to fulfil. The first four Heirs in the Succession are members of your Court, and their Ratings will affect your Global Yields. (For example, an Heir with high Wisdom will increase your Science.)
